capabilities: Display a dashboard of enrolled courses, announcements, and upcoming deadlines
Sync courses and assignments from Google Classroom on demand
Tag assignments with relative due-date badges such as Due Today or Overdue
Generate a Markdown note per assignment with instructions, due date, materials, and a deliverables checklist
Filter out completed or archived courses
extras: Before connecting, users must create their own Google Cloud project, enable the Google Classroom API, and generate a Desktop OAuth client ID and secret; the README also includes a Spanish quick-setup guide and links to a privacy policy. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull Google Classroom courses, announcements, and assignment deadlines into a vault.

relations.evidence: Connect your Google Classroom account to visualize courses, track upcoming assignments with smart urgency badges

requires.name: Self-created Google Cloud OAuth client ID and secret

summary: Syncs Google Classroom courses and assignments into Obsidian, with a dashboard, urgency badges, and auto-generated Markdown study notes.
